'''Ironstone Plateau''' is a region in northeastern [[Un'Goro Crater]]{{coords|77|33|Un'Goro Crater}}. It is home to fledgling [[Pterrordax]], and features several stretches of bare rock tucked on the bare edge of the crater wall. Its secluded and monster-free area sometimes attracts guilds to hold guild meets there.
